name: jwt-jws-engine
prompt: Implement a complete JWT (RFC 7519) + JWS (RFC 7515) + JWE (RFC 7516) cryptographic engine from scratch in Python without using ANY external cryptography libraries (no cryptography, pycryptodome, hashlib, hmac, secrets, or similar). Requirements: 1) Fetch and read RFC 7515 (JWS), RFC 7516 (JWE), and RFC 7518 (Algorithms) from IETF website to understand exact specifications, 2) Implement Base64URL encoding per RFC 4648 Section 5, 3) Implement these algorithms from pure math: RS256 (RSA-SHA256 signature), ES256 (ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256), A256GCM (AES-256-GCM encryption), RSA-OAEP (key encryption), 4) Implement SHA-256 hash from scratch using the algorithm described in FIPS 180-4, 5) Implement prime generation with Miller-Rabin primality test for RSA key generation, 6) Support both JWS (signed tokens) and JWE (encrypted tokens) with proper header parameters, 7) Find and implement all test vectors from RFC 7515 Appendix A to validate correctness, 8) Include timing-attack-resistant comparison for signature verification. The implementation must pass all RFC test vectors and handle edge cases like invalid signatures, expired tokens, and malformed inputs.
description: Tests advanced cryptographic implementation, RFC specification compliance, security best practices, and ability to research and implement complex standards from authoritative sources
